4.4.PalaeopositionandreconstructionsofIndochinaBlock
In the last two decades, a number of palaeomagnetic studies
have been focused on Indochina, Shan Thai, and South China
blocks. The extrusionmodel of the INC is the most accepted tec-
tonic model for Southeast Asia (Tapponnier et al., 1982, 1986;
Rowley, 1996; Replumaz and Tapponnier, 2003; Replumaz et al.,
2004; Ali and Aitchison, 2007, 2008). After India–Asia collision,
